test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 09 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: What is the role of ribosomes of a polysome?

options.text: The ribosomes of a polysome translate the mRNA into proteins.
The ribosomes of a polysome translate the rRNA into proteins.
The ribosomes of a monosome translate the rRNA into proteins.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The ribosomes of a polysome translate the mRNA into proteins**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Ribosomes of a Polysome 

 
 
• The cellular organelles known as ribosomes are made up of proteins and rRNA.
 
• Before they bind to mRNA, they are present free in the cytoplas
